findings.claim: FY2026（截至2026-03-31）關稅成本支付與客戶回收使營收與銷貨成本約變動1%，對獲利影響可忽略；公司以轉嫁給客戶為原則。
findings.excerpt: During the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, tariff costs paid and recoveries from our customers impacted our revenues and costs of goods by approximately one percent and had a negligible impact on our profitability.

findings.claim: 最高法院2026-02-20推翻IEEPA關稅，美國政府2026-04-20開放退稅機制；公司考慮申請退稅，預期不具重大影響。
findings.excerpt: On February 20, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court struck down tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act ("IEEPA") and on April 20, 2026 the U.S. government opened a system to facilitate refunds for IEEPA tariffs paid.

findings.claim: 風險因子：公司因關稅與貿易行動在成本回收時點與營運複雜度上持續受影響。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: As a global manufacturing and supply chain services partner with operations, suppliers, and customers across multiple jurisdictions, we have been, and expect to continue to be, impacted by tariffs and trade actions through the timing and mechanics of cost recovery and operational complexity.

findings.claim: 公司在中國有重大營運，受中國相關法規與地緣政治發展影響。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: We have significant operations in China, which have been, and could continue to be, affected by evolving laws, regulations, and geopolitical developments involving China.

findings.claim: USMCA於2026年進行聯合檢討，公司揭露協定可能被修改、暫停或終止的風險。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: The USMCA is subject to a joint review process in 2026, and there can be no assurance 25 Table of Contents that the agreement will not be amended, suspended, or terminated
